assumptions.side_once: all optional main encounters on each mode; 12 side quests once on Easy
assumptions.all_each_mode: all optional main encounters and side quests on each mode
assumptions.excluded: deaths, extra replays, respawns, boosts, tutorial planning-only awards
assumptions.totalXP: potential cumulative XP before Lv80 cap; XP at Lv80 is discarded in game
assumptions.limits: calculation, not observed client play or measured clear time
